functions.name: create-recording-download
functions.description: Start preparation of a downloadable recording file and return its download ID and current status. Audio-only recordings may already be complete; video is prepared asynchronously.

recordingId.description: Opaque decimal recording ID from list-meetings.

destinationUrl.description: Optional authorized HTTP(S) URL for Fathom to POST the completed download payload once; omit to check status with get-recording-download.

FunctionInput_fathom_createrecordingdown.description: Recording and optional one-shot completion destination for a new download request.

id.description: Opaque download ID to pass as downloadId to get-recording-download; private to the creating API client.

audio.description: Completed audio-only recording file, present when supplied by Fathom.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL for exact media bytes, usable until expiresAt; not fetched by this tool.

expiresAt.description: File and signed-URL expiration instant normalized to UTC Z with source precision preserved; request a new download afterward.

contentType.description: Provider media MIME type, preserved without inferring it from audio/video placement.

fileSizeBytes.description: Generated media file size in bytes, preserved exactly.

video.description: Completed video recording file, present when supplied by Fathom.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL for exact media bytes, usable until expiresAt; not fetched by this tool.

expiresAt.description: File and signed-URL expiration instant normalized to UTC Z with source precision preserved; request a new download afterward.

contentType.description: Provider media MIME type, preserved without inferring it from audio/video placement.

fileSizeBytes.description: Generated media file size in bytes, preserved exactly.

status.description: Current download-generation state, not recipient delivery status.

recordingId.description: Opaque recording identifier returned by Fathom.

failureReason.description: Provider generation failure reason, present when the download failed.

FunctionOutput_fathom_createrecordingdow.description: Initial download-generation state and any completed media files, without waiting for video generation.

tags.instructions: Obtain recordingId from `list-meetings`. This creates a download request, not a completed-file guarantee. If processing, use `get-recording-download` with the returned id and recordingId on the same API client. Completed file URLs are short-lived; request a new download after expiresAt. Limited-access shares cannot download. An optional destination receives one completion payload, not recurring notifications.

functions.name: delete-webhook
functions.description: Delete a known webhook registration so it no longer remains registered for future meeting-content notifications. This does not delete meeting content.

webhookId.description: Opaque ID of the existing webhook registration to delete, obtained from stored application configuration.

FunctionInput_fathom_deletewebhook.description: The existing webhook registration to remove.

deleted.description: True only after a successful provider deletion response; does not establish cancellation of already in-flight notifications.

webhookId.description: ID of the webhook whose deletion Fathom acknowledged.

FunctionOutput_fathom_deletewebhook.description: Local acknowledgement of the webhook registration deletion, not deletion of meeting content.

tags.instructions: Use this to remove an existing webhook, not to create or renew one. Obtain the webhook ID from the application's stored configuration; no webhook-list tool is available. Deletion has no documented restore operation, and this tool does not promise to recall notifications already in flight.

functions.name: get-recording-download
functions.description: Get the current state of a previously created recording download and its signed media URL when complete.

downloadId.description: Opaque id returned by create-recording-download using this same API client.

recordingId.description: Opaque decimal recording ID associated with the download.

FunctionInput_fathom_getrecordingdownloa.description: Identifiers of the existing recording download to check.

id.description: Opaque download ID returned by Fathom.

audio.description: Completed audio-only media file when supplied.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL for exact media bytes; not fetched by this tool.

expiresAt.description: File and URL expiration instant in UTC Z, retaining source fractional precision.

contentType.description: Provider MIME type, preserved unchanged even if surprising for the media category.

fileSizeBytes.description: Generated media size in bytes, preserved exactly.

video.description: Completed video media file when supplied.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL for exact media bytes; not fetched by this tool.

expiresAt.description: File and URL expiration instant in UTC Z, retaining source fractional precision.

contentType.description: Provider MIME type, preserved unchanged even if surprising for the media category.

fileSizeBytes.description: Generated media size in bytes, preserved exactly.

status.description: Current generation or expiration state, not delivery status.

recordingId.description: Opaque recording ID associated with this download.

failureReason.description: Provider generation failure reason when supplied for a failed download.

FunctionOutput_fathom_getrecordingdownlo.description: One current download status snapshot, including generated media when supplied.

tags.instructions: First call `create-recording-download`, then provide its id as downloadId and its recordingId. Use the same API client that created the download. This returns one status snapshot without waiting. If processing, check again later; if expired, create a new download. URLs are only usable until expiresAt.

functions.name: get-recording-summary
functions.description: Get the default English summary for a known recording as Markdown and its template name.

recordingId.description: Opaque decimal recording ID returned by list-meetings; do not interpret it as a time or number.

FunctionInput_fathom_getrecordingsummary.description: The known recording whose default English summary to retrieve.

recordingId.description: Recording identifier supplied by the caller.

templateName.description: Provider's default summary template name, or null.

markdown.description: English summary Markdown, preserving Unicode and whitespace; null and empty string are distinct provider values.

FunctionOutput_fathom_getrecordingsummar.description: The retrieved default English summary and its template name.

tags.instructions: Obtain recordingId from `list-meetings`. Use this for summary content returned directly to you; use `send-recording-summary` for a one-time POST to a destination URL, or `get-recording-transcript` for speaker-attributed source text.

functions.name: get-recording-transcript
functions.description: Get a recording's transcript as ordered speaker-attributed text segments with meeting-relative positions in seconds.

recordingId.description: Opaque decimal recording ID from list-meetings.

FunctionInput_fathom_getrecordingtranscr.description: Recording whose transcript should be retrieved.

recordingId.description: Recording identifier supplied by the caller.

displayName.description: Speaker display name as supplied by Fathom.

matchedCalendarInviteeEmail.description: Exact calendar-invitee email match; null means no exact match, while upstream omission stays omitted.

speaker.description: Speaker attribution and any exact calendar-invitee match.

text.description: Ordinary transcript text preserving original language, Unicode, punctuation, and whitespace.

meetingOffsetSeconds.description: Whole seconds from meeting start, converted from provider HH:MM:SS; not an absolute instant.

items.description: One source transcript segment with its speaker and meeting-relative position.

segments.description: All transcript segments returned by the direct recording endpoint, in original order; [] remains empty.

FunctionOutput_fathom_getrecordingtransc.description: Recording transcript in original order with speaker attribution and positions in seconds.

tags.instructions: Obtain recordingId from `list-meetings`. Use this for source speech text, not the English summary returned by `get-recording-summary`. Use `send-recording-transcript` to request a one-time POST to a destination URL. Positions are relative to meeting start, not wall-clock timestamps.

functions.name: list-meeting-types
functions.description: List one page of the organization's active and inactive meeting types for discovery and meeting filtering.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from list-meeting-types on this connection; omit for the first page.

FunctionInput_fathom_listmeetingtypes.description: Options for retrieving one page of organization meeting types.

name.description: Exact meeting type name usable as the meetingType filter.

status.description: Active types are assignable going forward; inactive types are historical and no longer assigned going forward.

createdAt.description: Type creation instant in UTC Z, preserving supplied fractional precision.

items.description: An organization meeting type, including its lifecycle status and creation instant.
One provider-sized page of meeting types in provider order.

functions.name: list-meetings
functions.description: List one page of accessible meetings, optionally filtered by creation time, recorder, team, company domain, or meeting type, with optional action items, highlights, and CRM matches.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from this connection and the same meeting filters; omit for the first page.

teamNames.description: Return meetings belonging to any listed team name.

meetingType.description: Exact meeting type name from list-meeting-types. An unknown name returns an empty page.

createdAfter.description: Exclusive lower bound on meeting creation time, with Z or an explicit numeric offset; fractional seconds are preserved.

createdBefore.description: Exclusive upper bound on meeting creation time, with Z or an explicit numeric offset; fractional seconds are preserved.

companyDomains.description: Exact company domains; matches meetings associated with any listed domain, not every invitee domain. Each meeting is associated with one company.

recorderEmails.description: Return meetings recorded by any listed email address.

includeCrmMatches.description: Include matches from your or your team's linked CRM; no linked CRM is reported within crmMatches.error.

includeHighlights.description: Include highlighted recording moments and their positions in seconds.

includeActionItems.description: Include English action items and their assignment and completion details.

inviteeDomainsType.description: Whether to include all meetings or only those with internal-only or at least one external invitee domain.

FunctionInput_fathom_listmeetings.description: Filters and optional enrichments for one page of accessible Fathom meetings.

recordingId.description: Opaque recording identifier, also identifying this meeting in the available API.

meetingTitle.description: Calendar event title; null is retained.

meetingType.description: Assigned meeting type name, or null when unassigned.

shareUrl.description: Fathom share URL; returning it does not change sharing permissions.

meetingUrl.description: Underlying meeting join URL, null without an associated calendar meeting; omitted if absent upstream.

createdAt.description: Meeting creation instant normalized to UTC Z without precision loss.

scheduledStartAt.description: Scheduled meeting start instant in UTC Z.

scheduledEndAt.description: Scheduled meeting end instant in UTC Z.

recordingStartAt.description: Actual recording start instant in UTC Z.

recordingEndAt.description: Actual recording end instant in UTC Z.

inviteeDomainsType.description: Whether calendar invitee domains are internal-only or include external domains.

sharedWith.description: Organization sharing state: private to recorder, one team, multiple teams, or all teams, respectively.

transcriptLanguage.description: Provider's transcript language code, preserved unchanged.

isExternal.description: Whether the invitee is external to the organization.

calendarInvitees.description: Calendar invitees, preserving order and null identity fields.

actionItems.description: Optional English action items; omission, null, and an empty array remain distinct.

description.description: Action item description, supplied by Fathom in English.

userGenerated.description: Whether the action item was user-generated.

completed.description: Whether the action item is complete.

recordingOffsetSeconds.description: Position in whole seconds from recording start, converted from HH:MM:SS.

recordingPlaybackUrl.description: URL for playback at the action item's recording position.

assignee.description: Assigned user's available identity fields; nulls are retained.

highlights.description: Optional highlighted moments; omission, null, and an empty array remain distinct.

type.description: Label of the bookmark that produced this highlight.

text.description: Full highlight text; omitted upstream when identical to summary.

startSeconds.description: Start position in seconds from recording start, preserving fractional seconds.

endSeconds.description: End position in seconds from recording start, preserving fractional seconds.

crmMatches.description: Optional linked CRM results, preserving absence and null; error can explain unavailable CRM data.

recordUrl.description: URL of the contact in the linked CRM.
URL of the company in the linked CRM.

amountDollars.description: Provider's deal amount in dollars, without currency conversion or an inferred ISO currency code.

recordUrl.description: URL of the deal in the linked CRM.

error.description: CRM-specific problem such as no CRM connected; not a failure of the meeting listing.

items.description: One provider page of meetings in provider order; an empty array is a valid result.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next page; omitted when next_cursor is null.

FunctionOutput_fathom_listmeetings.description: One page of accessible meetings and its optional continuation token.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover meetings and recording IDs. Discover team names with `list-teams`, recorder emails with `list-team-members`, and type names with `list-meeting-types`. Pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` with unchanged filters to continue. Use `get-recording-summary` and `get-recording-transcript` for content. Results without recorder or team filters exclude calls from users external to your organization. One call returns one provider-sized page; page size is not configurable.

functions.name: list-users

createdAt.description: Provider creation instant, or invitation instant for invited users, normalized to UTC Z with source precision preserved.

permissions.description: Effective permission details; omitted for invited users, not replaced by null or empty permissions.

level.description: Own meetings only, one team, multiple teams, or all teams.

teamNames.description: Every team for all_teams, granted teams for team or multiple_teams, or [] for own_meetings.

teamNames.description: Every team for account_admin, administered teams for team_admin, or [] for none.

functions.name: send-recording-summary
functions.description: Request one-time asynchronous delivery of an existing recording's English summary to a destination URL. This is not a recurring subscription.

recordingId.description: Opaque decimal recording ID from list-meetings.

destinationUrl.description: HTTP or HTTPS endpoint to receive Fathom's one-time summary POST; use only a destination authorized to receive this content.

FunctionInput_fathom_sendrecordingsummar.description: Recording and authorized destination for one-time asynchronous summary delivery.

recordingId.description: Recording whose summary delivery was requested.

destinationUrl.description: Destination acknowledged by Fathom; this is not proof of completed delivery.

FunctionOutput_fathom_sendrecordingsumma.description: Acknowledgement of the requested summary destination, not completed delivery.

tags.instructions: Use this only when the user wants the summary posted to an external destination. Obtain recordingId from `list-meetings`; use `get-recording-summary` instead to read it here. A successful response acknowledges the destination, not delivery. Repeating a call may cause another POST.

functions.name: send-recording-transcript
functions.description: Request one-time asynchronous delivery of an existing recording's transcript to a destination URL, without registering a recurring notification subscription.

recordingId.description: Opaque decimal recording ID from list-meetings.

destinationUrl.description: Authorized HTTP or HTTPS endpoint to receive Fathom's one-time transcript POST.

FunctionInput_fathom_sendrecordingtransc.description: Recording and authorized destination for one-time asynchronous transcript delivery.

recordingId.description: Recording whose transcript delivery was requested.

destinationUrl.description: Destination acknowledged by Fathom, not a delivery receipt.

FunctionOutput_fathom_sendrecordingtrans.description: Acknowledgement of the transcript destination, without confirmation of delivery.

tags.instructions: Use this when the transcript should be posted to an authorized external endpoint. Obtain recordingId from `list-meetings`. Use `get-recording-transcript` instead to receive normalized segments here. Success acknowledges the destination, not completed delivery. Repeating the request may send another POST.
